---
title: "QoL death-inclusive Markov — model fitting"
subtitle: "First-order ordinal transition models for 8 completed datasets"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

A Bayesian first-order ordinal transition model is fitted to each of the eight
independently completed longitudinal datasets. Death is state 8 and absorbing.
The model uses the imputed previous state; the partial proportional-odds term
permits the time effect to differ across outcome cut-points. The formula is
never simplified automatically. The default run retains 3,000 posterior draws
across four chains; a failed diagnostic check triggers the existing longer
retry run.

```{r}
#| label: fit-death-inclusive-longitudinal-qol
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(rmsb)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
n_imputations <- 8L
indices <- seq_len(n_imputations)
default_retained_draws <- 3000L
if (default_retained_draws %% config$markov$chains != 0L) {
  stop("Default retained draws must be divisible by the number of chains.")
}
default_draws_per_chain <- default_retained_draws / config$markov$chains
default_warmup <- as.integer(default_draws_per_chain)
default_iterations <- as.integer(default_warmup + default_draws_per_chain)
output_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-death-inclusive-longitudinal"
)
imputation_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "imputations")
model_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "models")
diagnostic_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "model")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(diagnostic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pcontrast_tx <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.5
)
model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev +
  ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis_code + cluster(id)
fit_specification <- list(
  formula = paste(deparse(model_formula), collapse = " "),
  r_version = as.character(getRversion()),
  mostr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("mostr")),
  mostr_built = utils::packageDescription("mostr")[["Built"]],
  required_fit_wrapper = "blrm_markov",
  require_starting_profile_metadata = TRUE,
  chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
  default_iterations = default_iterations,
  default_warmup = default_warmup,
  default_retained_draws = default_retained_draws,
  retry_iterations = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations),
  retry_warmup = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L)
)

diagnostic_failure_reason <- function(diagnostics, thresholds) {
  summary <- as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary)
  reasons <- character()
  finite_rhat <- summary$rhat[is.finite(summary$rhat)]
  finite_bulk <- summary$ess_bulk[is.finite(summary$ess_bulk)]
  finite_tail <- summary$ess_tail[is.finite(summary$ess_tail)]
  if (length(finite_rhat) == 0L) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "R-hat was unavailable")
  } else if (max(finite_rhat) > thresholds$max_rhat) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "maximum R-hat %.4f exceeded %.4f",
        max(finite_rhat),
        thresholds$max_rhat
      )
    )
  }
  if (length(finite_bulk) == 0L) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "bulk ESS was unavailable")
  } else if (min(finite_bulk) < thresholds$min_ess_bulk) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "minimum bulk ESS %.1f was below %.1f",
        min(finite_bulk),
        thresholds$min_ess_bulk
      )
    )
  }
  if (length(finite_tail) == 0L) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "tail ESS was unavailable")
  } else if (min(finite_tail) < thresholds$min_ess_tail) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "minimum tail ESS %.1f was below %.1f",
        min(finite_tail),
        thresholds$min_ess_tail
      )
    )
  }
  if (
    diagnostics$divergent_transitions >
      thresholds$max_divergent_transitions
  ) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      paste(diagnostics$divergent_transitions, "divergent transitions")
    )
  }
  if (diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded > thresholds$max_treedepth_exceeded) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      paste(diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded, "treedepth exceedances")
    )
  }
  if (
    is.finite(diagnostics$min_bfmi) &&
      diagnostics$min_bfmi < thresholds$min_bfmi
  ) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "minimum E-BFMI %.3f was below %.3f",
        diagnostics$min_bfmi,
        thresholds$min_bfmi
      )
    )
  }
  if (length(reasons) == 0L) "None" else paste(reasons, collapse = "; ")
}

for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(
    imputation_dir,
    sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  model_metadata_path <- file.path(
    model_dir,
    sprintf("model-%02d-metadata.rds", index)
  )
  diagnostic_path <- file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  fit_attempt_path <- file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("fit-attempts-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
    stop("Missing completed longitudinal QoL dataset: ", data_path)
  }
  cached_specification <- if (file.exists(model_metadata_path)) {
    readRDS(model_metadata_path)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  cached_model_has_required_metadata <- FALSE
  cached_model_reasons <- character()
  if (file.exists(model_path)) {
    cached_model <- readRDS(model_path)
    if (!identical(attr(cached_model, "markov_fit_wrapper"), "blrm_markov")) {
      cached_model_reasons <- c(
        cached_model_reasons,
        "cached fit lacks blrm_markov() provenance required by R 4.6.1"
      )
    }
    if (
      is.null(attr(cached_model, "markov_starting_profile_data")) ||
        is.null(attr(cached_model, "markov_starting_profile_metadata"))
    ) {
      cached_model_reasons <- c(
        cached_model_reasons,
        paste(
          "cached fit lacks starting-profile metadata required for",
          "random-effects marginalization"
        )
      )
    }
    cached_model_has_required_metadata <- length(cached_model_reasons) == 0L
    rm(cached_model)
  }
  model_is_current <-
    file.exists(model_path) &&
    file.exists(diagnostic_path) &&
    file.exists(fit_attempt_path) &&
    identical(cached_specification, fit_specification) &&
    cached_model_has_required_metadata
  if (!force && model_is_current) next

  refit_reasons <- cached_model_reasons
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    refit_reasons <- c(refit_reasons, "no cached model artifact exists")
  }
  if (!file.exists(diagnostic_path)) {
    refit_reasons <- c(refit_reasons, "no cached diagnostic artifact exists")
  }
  if (!identical(cached_specification, fit_specification)) {
    refit_reasons <- c(
      refit_reasons,
      "cached fit specification or R/package runtime differs"
    )
  }
  if (force) {
    refit_reasons <- c(
      refit_reasons,
      "forced refit requested with LIQPLAT_FORCE=1"
    )
  }
  refit_reason <- paste(unique(refit_reasons), collapse = "; ")

  data <- arrow::read_parquet(data_path) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      y = as.integer(as.character(y)),
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:7),
      ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE),
      diagnosis_code = factor(diagnosis_code)
    )
  model_variables <- all.vars(model_formula)
  if (
    anyNA(data[model_variables]) ||
      anyNA(data$id) ||
      anyDuplicated(data[c("id", "week")]) ||
      any(!data$y %in% 1:8)
  ) {
    stop("Completed dataset ", index, " is not valid for Markov model fitting.")
  }

  dd <- rms::datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")
  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 500L)

  model <- mostr::blrm_markov(
    formula = model_formula,
    pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
    ppo = ~week,
    cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
    data = data,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = default_iterations,
    warmup = default_warmup,
    refresh = 0L,
    backend = "cmdstan",
    loo = FALSE,
    sampling.args = list(
      seed = fit_seed,
      parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
    )
  )
  diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)
  fit_attempts <- tibble(
    imputation = index,
    attempt = 1L,
    iterations_per_chain = default_iterations,
    warmup_per_chain = default_warmup,
    retained_draws_per_chain = default_iterations - default_warmup,
    refit_reason = refit_reason,
    diagnostics_passed = isTRUE(diagnostics$passed),
    diagnostic_failure_reason = diagnostic_failure_reason(
      diagnostics,
      config$diagnostics
    ),
    r_version = as.character(getRversion()),
    mostr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("mostr")),
    fit_wrapper = attr(model, "markov_fit_wrapper") %||% NA_character_,
    starting_profile_metadata_stored =
      !is.null(attr(model, "markov_starting_profile_metadata"))
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(fit_attempts, fit_attempt_path, compression = "zstd")

  if (!isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    retry_reason <- paste0(
      "Initial fit failed diagnostics: ",
      diagnostic_failure_reason(diagnostics, config$diagnostics)
    )
    model <- mostr::blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
      ppo = ~week,
      cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)
    fit_attempts <- bind_rows(
      fit_attempts,
      tibble(
        imputation = index,
        attempt = 2L,
        iterations_per_chain = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations),
        warmup_per_chain = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L),
        retained_draws_per_chain = as.integer(
          config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L
        ),
        refit_reason = retry_reason,
        diagnostics_passed = isTRUE(diagnostics$passed),
        diagnostic_failure_reason = diagnostic_failure_reason(
          diagnostics,
          config$diagnostics
        ),
        r_version = as.character(getRversion()),
        mostr_version = as.character(
          utils::packageVersion("mostr")
        ),
        fit_wrapper = attr(model, "markov_fit_wrapper") %||% NA_character_,
        starting_profile_metadata_stored =
          !is.null(attr(model, "markov_starting_profile_metadata"))
      )
    )
    arrow::write_parquet(fit_attempts, fit_attempt_path, compression = "zstd")
  }
  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  saveRDS(fit_specification, model_metadata_path)
  diagnostic_output <- as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary) |>
    mutate(
      imputation = index,
      divergent_transitions = diagnostics$divergent_transitions,
      treedepth_exceeded = diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded,
      min_bfmi = diagnostics$min_bfmi
    )
  arrow::write_parquet(
    diagnostic_output,
    diagnostic_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}

fit_attempt_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(indices, function(index) {
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("fit-attempts-%02d.parquet", index)
  )) |>
    as.data.frame()
})
arrow::write_parquet(
  fit_attempt_summary,
  file.path(diagnostic_dir, "fit-attempts-all.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

options(datadist = NULL)
```
